terms.comment: Our descriptive “recipient list” from the email-platform discussion. catalogus, catalogī m. — catalogue or list; dēstinātārius, dēstinātāriī m. is modern vocabulary for a recipient; the full phrase is not claimed as an established platform label.

The computing glossary instead proposes grex Internetī for a mailing list. That emphasizes a group; an email-marketing platform’s stored list of recipients can be described more directly with catalogus. These alternatives need not name exactly the same kind of resource.

phrases.english: Add this recipient to the list.

sources: Lewis & Short: catalogus · Vocabula computatralia: list. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.
The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
